text_block_list.text:
I thought I heard somebody calling my
name,
but...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It seems there's nobody here. Was I
hearing
things?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Could it have been... the statue of the
Three
Goddesses?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
